requirement: The change stays on-ticket: refactoring that supports the fix (extracting helpers, restructuring the touched code paths) is fine, but there are no unrelated drive-by edits - no changes to files or behaviours the ticket does not touch, no opportunistic cleanup elsewhere
The change follows the codebase's existing idioms: Effect combinators, tagged error types, naming, biome style
The change introduces no new public API surface and keeps existing public shapes intact
The submission includes the release bookkeeping this repo requires for a user-facing change: a changeset entry and/or a consistent version bump
